customManagers.description: Track chunkah OCI image version and digest pinned as shell variables in chunka/action.yml

packageRules.description: Automerge chore dep updates (digest, pin, patch, minor) when CI passes

Never manage projectbluefin/actions refs - first-party actions use the floating @v1 tag, advanced deliberately by the actions release process. SHA pinning defends against tag hijacking on repos we do not control; it does not apply to first-party code. Keep last so it wins over the automerge rule above.
